title: TransactionExportLinkSuccessResponse
description: 200 flat envelope for POST {BASE_ROUTE}/export/bulk/loan-transactions (response_type link/data) and POST {BASE_ROUTE}/export/export-now/loan-transactions (GROUP 8). Shape varies with data volume: empty => {data:[],message:"no data found"}; link => {output:"<S3 url>",message:"success"}; data => {data:[rows],message:"success"}. message is always present; output OR data may be present. No success/error keys.
